Container.Name: Unifi to Discord webhook
Container.Overview:
This is a tiny webhook listener that listens for Unifi's webhooks sent to the docker container's IP:PORT and formats the message to a Discord webhook.
Open the WebUI (first login admin / admin) to set the Discord webhook and add your cameras by MAC address and name. Visit the project's repo for a read me.

Config.Name: WEB_PORT
Config.Description: Port for the setup page. Change this to reach the page on a different port; the WebUI link follows it.

Config.Name: WEBHOOK_PORT
Config.Description: Port Unifi sends its alarm webhooks to. Set the Unifi delivery URL to http://[IP]:[this port]/data

Config.Name: appdata
Config.Description: Settings (settings.json: cameras, webhook, password) and logs are stored here. Keep this mapped or settings are lost when the container is updated.
